name: cf-tax-overview
description: Use this Central African Republic tax overview for 2026 research intake, routing and the directly read procedural amendments. It maps individual tax, corporate profit, VAT, payroll, related parties, cross-border clearance, formation and property to their dedicated Guides, then sets out the general LPF penalty and notice controls verified in the signed 2025 Finance Act. Search triggers include DGID, tax calendar, penalties, NIU, tax complaint and audit information request. It keeps country-pack presence separate from comprehensive coverage. The full new 2024 procedure book, later amendments, tax-specific penalty priority and live filing channels remain incomplete, so this map cannot certify filing compliance.
